jobs.title: Program Management Dir - L7
jobs.location: Sunnyvale, CA; Huntsville, AL; Denver, CO
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

The mission matters. So do the people behind it. With advancing defense technology at our core, what sets us apart is a culture of collaboration, purpose, and impact.

What is the mission?

The Vice President of the Next Generation Interceptor (NGI) Program is seeking an experienced Executive Program Manager for the role of All Up Round (AUR) Director .
This All Up Round (AUR) Program Director position provides program management and leadership of the NGI Program specifically to coordinate in house Production across the three major hardware segments - Mission Support Vehicle, Kill Vehicle, Booster into an integrated AUR delivery to NGI customer base.  In the role, the Program Director will ensure seamless synchronization of activities across the Segments and represent the holistic interests of the program in interfacing and partnering with the LM Space Operations organization for manufacturing across all LM make locations. Responsibilities include procurement activities, preparations of the Courtland Missile Assembly Building (MAB) NGI AUR assembly and test operations including any AUR support equipment.  In this role, the Director will also oversee other critical program activities including development demonstrations, either ground based or flight,  funded either through LM IRAD or cost shared by the NGI Customer.

This role will offer you the following daily challenges:
Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, proposal work statements and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Develops new business or expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.

Basic Qualifications

To be effective, you will need to possess these basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of highly effective leadership experience with a proven ability to manage through complex environment.
- Project or Program management / leadership experience with demonstrated ability to meet cost, schedule, and technical objectives
- Experience as a CAM or with earned value management (EVM) principles
- Prior Program Management, IRAD, or CRAD execution experience
- Experience interfacing with company executives, customers and external agencies
- Experience with risk and opportunity management
- Experience with integrated planning or equivalent
- You will need to be a US Citizen , and currently possess and be able to maintain a US TOP SECRET clearance ,to support this government contract, as well as successfully pass a drug and background check, in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Desired Skills

To be effective, ideally, you should also have:
- Leadership experience with demonstrated customer, internal product center, and supplier partnerships; recent leadership in satellite development, missile and/or weapon system development, production and/or sustainment
- Leadership experience within major functional organizations that provide a deep understanding of program/Functional interdependencies and synergies
- Experience maintaining positive working relationships with government customers.
- Proven ability to interface with company senior leadership and external customers at all levels.
- Strong business acumen, including negotiation and conflict management.
- Possess a thorough knowledge of financial/business analysis, government contracts/acquisition, technology and business planning.
- Experience with new business budget/execution; FAR/DFAR proposal development and negotiations Demonstrated experience with earned value and program management tools and processes .
- Demonstrated capability in the areas of Integrated Master Schedule/Integrated Master Plan, Subcontract Management.

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

TS/SCI clearance required.
This Program Manager role provides support to operational satellite ground systems, satellite operations centers (SOCs), and other support services program at Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The organization’s goal is to accelerate mission design and ground integration, launch and on-orbit operations, ground system tests, and rapid ﬁelding to provide reliable, low-cost access to space in support of the warﬁghter.  The LM team provides this support to the United States Space Force (USSF) and other Department of War offices being supported at the Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation (RDT&E) Support Complex (RSC) at Kirtland Air Force Base.
The Senior Program Manager will be responsible for the overall program including the Task Order technical execution and working with functional partners to staff, plan and execute existing and future efforts.  They will provide the organizational vision as well as tactical direction to ensure all efforts meet cost, schedule, and technical baselines.
Additionally, the Senior Program Manager will be responsible for capturing emerging work in the form of Task Orders in support of the USSF Customer.
The successful candidate should have experience executing technical, cost and schedule effort along with leading proposal development for continued program growth.  The PM will reside onsite at Kirtland Air Force Base with the Customer and is the primary interface with the Government.  Therefore, the position requires a strong communicator who has experience with both internal and external customers and comfortable engaging executive leadership.
This position is contingent upon program award expected by Nov. 2026.

Basic Qualifications

• Demonstrated leadership including building relationships with internal and external customers
• Experience interfacing with company executives, customers, and external agencies and partners
• Demonstrated program, capture, business, and/or contract management experience of the following:
- Cost, technical, schedule management
- Experience managing multiple Task Orders/projects simultaneously
- Proposal Development and Execution

• TS/SCI clearance

jobs.title: Business Development & Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

The Strike, Deterrence and Missile Defense Mission Strategy and Advanced Capabilities (SDMD MSAC) team is seeking a Business Development & Strategy Analyst Stf to support our pursuit of new business opportunities, strategic growth, and creation of new partnerships.
The selected candidate will aid in the development and execution of customer-focused strategy and capture opportunities, primarily within the Targets & Countermeasures business but also inclusive of Missile Defense capabilities. They will be accountable for identifying and supporting shaping of new and recompeted business through a balanced focus on customer value, the competitive environment, and the corporation's best interests. They will support capture strategies by identifying potential customers and/ or relevant solicitations and informing business solutions for pursuit of opportunities; executing competitive assessments and evaluating potential teaming partners; helping inform position-to-win (PTW) narratives; and participating in bid and proposal activities across a matrixed and highly integrated team of professionals. This role will play a major part in exploring non-traditional business models, partnerships and other go-to-market activities to evolve Lockheed’s position. The selected candidate will support internal cross-functional briefings – up to the executive level.
Engagement with key external customers and the ability to build customer relationships is key to success in this role. The ideal candidate will bring a strong perspective on how to shape market requirements and evolve Lockheed Martin’s capabilities to meet future requirements competitively. A mix of Department of War and federal government contracting with strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills is key. A technical baseline of capabilities with the missile defense industry is strongly preferred, but not required.
In this dynamic role, your key responsibilities will include:
• Lead new business pursuits, shaping strategies, whitepaper and proposal development by conducting reviews, competitive analysis and developing the business case. Work cross-functionally to lead Capture Teams from shaping through program transition.
• Identify emerging and growing markets and opportunities while maintaining continuous, detailed insight into customer budgets and allocations. You will also perform economic analyses and explore business models best suited to growing markets.
• Understand and apply non-traditional business models and go-to-market motions to help think and execute differently; socialize and gain internal traction on new ways of doing business within the missile defense portfolio, proactively acknowledging and burning down risks.  Includes proactive shaping and/ or seeking out of CRAD, CRADA, SBIR, BAA etc opportunities for growth.
• Develop mission value through the application of our IRAD technologies, work closely with customers to define mission success and accelerate our technical capabilities.
• Develop a positive and evolved LM brand identity in the customer communities covering the full spectrum of the technical portfolio.
• Develop detailed senior customer advocacy plans for core customers in DoW and for new and expanding customers in other national and international federal agencies. Identify our value proposition for each, our messages to shape opportunities and deliver value, and milestones for achieving agreement on specific issues.
• Assess customer strategic capability gap requirements and advocate advanced program technology solutions, planning, business opportunity identification and validation, capture plan development and execution, and customer interaction management – specifically within the Targets and Countermeasures and Kinetic Effectors portfolios.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in Aerospace, Engineering, Business or related field
• +5 years of experience in Aerospace and Defense
• Prior experience in flight testing, design engineering, operations analysis, or systems engineering
• Experience with Mission Architecting
• Basic understanding of typical DoW program structures, milestones and timelines
• Experience in leading business development and/or competitive capture initiatives with a track record of success within the Department of War
• Proven management and leadership skills with demonstrated ability to interact confidently with peers, executives, both internal and external stakeholders
• Demonstrated ability to proactively collaborate, drive change, and navigate complex matrixed environments with competing priorities
• Detail oriented and ability to multi-task; strong organizational skills and attention to detail
• Demonstrated expertise in communicating/briefing managers, employees, and customers
• US Citizen with Active DoW Secret Clearance is required

Desired Skills

• Ability to leverage technical and managerial relationships to assist with the identification of opportunities that align with the strategy
• Demonstrated, excellent written and oral communication skills
• Prior experience as technical and/or programmatic lead
• Prior experience with MDA, Navy, Space Force, Air Force, and/ or Army customers
• Demonstrated success leading capture teams, proposal teams, strategy development, and customer solutioning
• Strong grasp of non-traditional, commercial and / or disruptive business models and implications to financing, contracting, programmatic and legal risks
• Executive-level presentation skills with the ability to tell a concise and compelling story
• Expert-level Microsoft suite skills, including PowerPoint

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING
At Lockheed Martin, we are dedicated to supporting our global MH-60R/S customers through capability development, Obsolescence / Diminishing Manufacturing Sources & Material Shortages (DMSMS) management and resolution, and  product line sustainment. Our team in Owego, NY, plays a key role in ensuring the ongoing success of these platforms for both the U.S. Navy and our Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. We are seeking a strong Development Program Manager to continue decades-long success developing avionics and platform hardware and software solutions to support our customers.
THE WORK
The Program Manager’s responsibilities will include managing program cost, schedule, and technical performance with active risk and opportunity management process adherence, baseline activities, and CDRL Development, and will:
•    Perform program management leadership activities in support of executing requirements relating to milestones and contractual deliveries including metric development, administration, best practice implementation, and presentation development.
•    Develop and negotiate proposal submissions, as well as informal ROM style cost and technical assessments.
•    Work with Functional Leadership and Control Account Managers (CAMs)/Work Package Managers to development accurate cost and schedule projections, and mitigate cost and schedule variances.
•    Serve as the primary customer interface, facilitating collaboration and joint problem-solving with the U.S. and FMS stakeholders.
WHO WE ARE
Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and security, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technology that supports mission readiness. Our Owego-based team specializes in system, hardware, and software sustainment and development for the MH-60R/S platform, ensuring these aircraft remain at peak operational performance. We thrive on solving complex challenges and delivering innovative solutions to our customers worldwide.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a results-driven leader with significant experience in program management, particularly in managing complex defense and aerospace programs. You bring:
•    Excellent communication skills to build effective relationships with stakeholders at all LM and customer levels
•    Strong organizational skills, enabling you to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
•    Leadership qualities with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams
•    Demonstrated skills in metrics-driven performance management, risk identification and mitigation, and issue resolution.
•    Firm understanding of system engineering principles and practices

Basic Qualifications

•    Demonstrated skill proficiency in all routine Program Management areas typically found with 10+ years of experience.
•    Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a related discipline
•    Demonstrated success in leading and supporting multi-functional teams on multiple programs.
•    Demonstrated strong communication and interpersonal skills
•    Ability to acquire and maintain a Secret security clearance.
•    Ability to travel
•    Proficient in Earned Value Management and Analysis
•    Proficient in Risk/Issue/Opportunity Management
•    Experience as a Control Account Manager (CAM)

Desired Skills

•    Experience with NAVAIR PMA-299 and/or knowledge of the MH-60 R/S platforms
•    Experience with Development contracts
•    Experienced Team Leader
•    Experience with AGILE development processes and practices
•    Proficient Workload Planning and associated tools
•    Proposal development skills

WHAT WE'RE DOING
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we're on a mission to drive innovation and uphold the highest standards of business ethics. We believe that by pushing the boundaries of visionary thinking, we can achieve exceptional results. As a Lockheed Martin employee, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working in an environment that values integrity and excellence.

THE WORK
Join the Moorestown Operations Team! We are looking for a talented and motivated Operations Program Manager (OPM) to lead the Next Generation Launchers Manufacturing Project team. This role will need to balance and ensure the tactical execution of high profile production programs while designing and modernizing new ways of executing the same work with greater efficiency and effectiveness.

As an OPM, you will have full accountability to deliver on quality, cost and schedule for Next Gen Launchers. You will be responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition. This role will report to the Launching Systems MPM Sr. Manager.

In this role you will be responsible for:

• Directly managing a small team in the successful execution of Next Gen Launchers Programs specifically meeting quality, schedule and cost targets.
• Working across Moorestown teams including factory operations, program office, sourcing; and will ensure intra-LM/RMS scope is executed.
• Driving accountability and partnership across functions to deliver upon expectations.
• Leading strategy for continuously improving production performance.
• Personnel development and coaching

• Lead Prod Ops proposals efforts and develop accurate and competitive bids for future work
• Effectively communicate operations status and strategy to both senior leadership as well as the production execution team

You are a strategic leader with expertise in manufacturing and financial management who thrives in cross-functional environments. You possess the ability to manage complex production targets while coaching teams toward operational excellence.

A level 5 employee is senior career and typically has 8+ years of related professional expereince.

WHY JOIN US
In this role you will have the opportunity to lead high-profile production programs and shape the future of launcher manufacturing in Moorestown. You will make a tangible impact on national security by balancing tactical execution with innovative modernization strategies.
Our benefits are built to match the caliber of your work. Reliable, high performing, and mission ready. You’ll enjoy world class resources, mentorship, continuous learning, competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive work life balance—all within a culture that values innovation, integrity, and collaboration.

jobs.title: Tech Domain Program Manager - High Speed Systems
jobs.location: Sunnyvale, CA; Highlands Ranch, CO; Moorestown, NJ
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Tech Domain Program Manager - High Speed Systems

Lockheed Martin's Technology Programs charter is to work collaboratively across the Corporation to develop strategic, longer-term, far-reaching capabilities needed to enable our 21st Century Security technology strategy.  Efforts span time horizons, with collaborative engagement across business areas (BAs) to drive capability transitions into program opportunities.

Our Corporate Research & Technology Programs organization is hiring a energetic, enthusiastic, and creative Program Manager (Principal) to work across the Corporation to lead the High Speed Systems Domain.

What You Will Be Doing:
In this role, you will play a vital role in defining our future by driving innovative solutions for our Customers through technology strategy, mission capability assessment, and research & development programs aimed at generation-after-next technologies.

You will lead the Domain-specific strategy, collaborate with cross business area IPTs, shape Customer Research & Development (CRAD) pursuits, and assist in the management of cross-Business Area (BA) IRAD programs ranging in size from $.5M to $20M annually. You will be responsible for strategic alignment and overall program performance including cost, schedule, and technical execution.

You will work collaboratively with Corporate Technology Office leadership, BA principal investigators, technical leads, and peer portfolio managers to accelerate and drive technology developments.

Further Information About This Opportunity:
This role is fully remote, but preference is for geographical alignment to a Lockheed Martin Hub.  Somewhat regular travel is required (~25%, but will fluctuate with business need).  Active Secret Clearance is required to start.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience working on Launch Systems, Missile programs, IRADs or programs with technical background in one or more of the following areas: - Hypersonic Flight Technologies
- Rocket Science
- Advanced Propulsion systems
- Missile Systems

- Experience on development programs that include capability development, implementation, integration, and testing
- Experience working with customers and proven technology transition
- Experience coordinating across multiple lines of business and multi-functional organizations for IRAD investments
- Experience converting strategy into prioritized IRAD products and deliverables combined with a business case investment strategy
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Active Secret Clearance

Desired Skills

- Familiarity with Stage Gate/R&D management processes
- Knowledge of Earned Value Management and/or Agile program management
- Working knowledge of Joint All Domain Operations (JADO) mission objects, DoD implementation, and Operations Analysis (OA) guided capability development
- Experience interfacing with company executives, customers, and external agencies and partners
- Proven ability to partner across internal business areas
- Advanced degree in a technical field
- Systems engineering and requirements development experience
- Demonstrated career progression in roles of increasing responsibilities

Pay Information
GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.
- Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $228100.00 - $423700.00  - Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.

- Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $205300.00 - $381300.00  - Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.

Standard Job Description

The MPM is embedded in a designated Product Center and serves as the single point of contact for all program‑wide cost, schedule, quality, risk, and change‑control activities. The role merges the strategic, financial, and operational duties of a Manufacturing Program Manager with the earned‑value reporting, financial‑accountability, and change‑control responsibilities of a Control‑Account Manager (CAM).

Key Responsibilities
- Program Integration  – Align and coordinate the Production Build Plan with Operations; ensure all manufacturing plans are developed, maintained, and executed on schedule and within budget.
- Strategic Translation  – Convert Product Center strategy into forecasting, resource allocation, and emerging earned‑value (EV) tracking for the CH‑53K program.
- Financial & Schedule Ownership  – Serve as the CAM for the Product Center, providing full financial accountability through EV reporting, variance analysis (EAC/ETC), and monthly status updates. Maintain the cost‑performance baseline.
- Performance Metrics  – Track and drive key indicators such as Performance Index (PI) and Hours Per Unit (HPU); ensure on‑time completion and support affordability goals.
- Reporting & Liaison  – Produce regular earned‑value/financial reports and coordinate with Program Management, Operations Finance, Program Finance, Quality Assurance, Industrial Engineering, and other stakeholders.
- Risk & Opportunity Management  – Maintain a risk register for the Product Center, identify, assess, and implement mitigation actions tied to the CH‑53K program.
- Performance‑Based Payments  – Manage, track, and communicate PBPs where applicable.
- Quality Coordination  – Partner with Quality to oversee scrap‑rework‑repair (SRR) activities and drive Quality Improvement Projects (QIPs).
- Affordability Leadership  – Own the center’s affordability initiatives, including Cost Reduction Initiatives (CRIs); translate outcomes into the program’s Estimate at Complete (EAC).
- Stakeholder Interface  – Act as the primary operations liaison between the Product Center and key internal and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment across the program.

Core Competencies
- Earned‑value management and variance analysis
- Integrated schedule and cost control
- Risk identification, assessment, and mitigation
- Cross‑functional collaboration and stakeholder management
- Data‑driven decision‑making using PI, HPU, and affordability metrics

The MPM ensures that the CH‑53K Product Center delivers on its commitments, maintains financial integrity, and continuously improves cost, schedule, and quality performance.

The Combat Rescue Helicopter (CRH) Program Manager is responsible for cost, schedule and technical execution of all aspects of the CRH program and reports directly to the Program Director, Combat Rescue Helicopter Program. Responsibilities span both the development and production of the CRH aircraft. This position is also accountable for risk and change management, team leadership and communications, and interface with internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, this role will also work collaboratively with the CRH cross-functional team to drive performance and adherence to customer milestones and expectations. This position is also responsible for meeting our short term and in support of long-term financial objectives.

The Work
The CRH Program Manager is responsible for providing Program Management planning and execution for the CRH program which includes:
- Report to the CRH Program Director and have P&L responsibility for the large aspects of program.

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

What is the mission?
The mission matters. So do the people behind it. With advancing defense technology at our core, what sets us apart is a culture of collaboration, purpose, and impact.
Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more— we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

This role will offer you the following daily challenges:
On the Next Generation Interceptor (NGI) Program, Supply Chain is a key driver in providing buy component responsible for approximately 50% of the program hardware development subcontracts totaling three billion dollars of supplier value. The subcontractors we manage are vital in supporting design, build and deployment of the next step forward in national security detecting, tracking and destroying incoming intercontinental ballistic missiles in space before they reach American soil.
This Subcontract Program Management (SPM) Manager position on NGI will be a key member of the NGI Subcontracts Leadership Team and will have as directs reports Subcontract Program(s) and associated staff.  In this role you will have the following daily key responsibilities:
- Support both the NGI Subcontracts Organization and the Operations & Sustainment (O&S) Integrated Product Team (IPT) in execution of the overall NGI program.
- Lead and manage a team of up to 5 personnel comprised of Subcontract Program Managers (SPMs), Subcontract Managers (SCM) and associated staff.
- Directly support the O&S IPT Lead on a day-to-day basis. Responsible for providing status reporting as required and supporting the overall IPT business rhythm
- Monitor and support each O&S Subcontract Management Team (SCMT) as they manage the overall cost, schedule and technical execution of their subcontractor. Each SCMT is expected to actively manage the supplier in delivering solutions on budget and schedule and develop and implement correction actions when necessary.
- Responsible for leading the SCMT and overall performance for one assigned subcontractor. Establishes milestone objectives to manage performance to committed schedules and contractual specifications. Leads a cross-functional team, normally composed of engineers, quality, and procurement personnel, to ensure successful subcontract execution and program delivery.
- Support all NGI proposal efforts
- Responsible for providing status reporting as required and support NGI program and Supply Chain business rhythm
- Travel (up to 30%) to the customer, program and subcontractor locations is required.

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education.
- 7+ years overall experience, with a minimum of 2 years of experience in a combination of subcontract and/or program management.
- 2+ years of overall experience in working with large (over $50M) subcontractors.
- 2+ years of CAM or EVM related experience
- 5+ years of overall experience as a program manager in the capture and development phase.
- Technical knowledge of missile or ground support system products.

You will need to be a US Citizen and be able to obtain and maintain a US DoD SECRET clearance, to support this government contract, as well as successfully pass a drug and background check, in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Position Summary
The Deputy Program Manager will support the establishment and five-year execution of the UAE Cybersecurity Center of Excellence (CoE), a national-scale initiative designed to advance cyber resilience, workforce development, research, innovation, and sovereign cybersecurity capability across the United Arab Emirates.
Working in close partnership with the Senior Program Manager, the Deputy Program Manager will help lead the CoE's integrated Strategy, Operations, and Capacity Building function. The role will translate strategic objectives established by Lockheed Martin, the UAE Cyber Security Council, Tawazun, Data7, and other stakeholders into executable program plans. The successful candidate will support the PM in coordinating delivery across the CoE's major pillars: National Security and Readiness, the UAE Cyber Academy, the Learning Experience Platform, the Industry and Society Platform, Innovation and Technology, and central CoE operations.
This position requires a leader who combines disciplined program execution with substantial cybersecurity and systems-engineering credibility. The Deputy Program Manager must be able to lead multidisciplinary teams, engage senior government and industry stakeholders, assess technical and programmatic risk, and connect cyber strategy to measurable operational outcomes. The role will be central to the CoE's build-operate-transfer model and the development of sustainable, UAE-led capabilities.

- Coordinate and complete AMMM Export Control on new license requests in International Trade Compliance Organization (ITCO) ECLPS System
- Ensure Supplier Statement of Work (SSOW), data requirements, and schedules are accurate and complete and flowed to the subcontractors.

The Strike, Deterrence and Missile Defense Mission Strategy and Advanced Capabilities (SDMD MSAC) team is seeking a Business Development and Strategy Analyst Stf to support our pursuit of new business opportunities, strategic growth, and creation of new partnerships. The selected candidate will aid in the development and execution of customer focused strategy and capture opportunities, primarily within the Targets and Countermeasures business but also inclusive of broader Missile Defense capabilities. Standard Job Description

Who we are:
We are a dynamic team at the cutting edge of National Security Space dedicated to developing innovative technologies that address the most unique and pressing customer challenges. Our collaborative culture fosters creativity, teamwork, and the pursuit of excellence for our programs and our suppliers.

Why join us:
This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of managing critical partnerships for key discriminating deliverables that drive the success of a quickly growing business area with tremendous opportunity for advancement.
The IC5 Subcontract Program Manager Sr Stf position is an exceptional opportunity for a high potential engineer to expand an already discriminating skillset to include subcontract type strategy, negotiations, and execution to deliver. This SPM role in particular provides proven engineering professionals with a path to program manager that sets them apart from their peers in gaining negotiation expertise with suppliers that regularly provide the most critical payloads to our customers and it gives a leg up in shaping contract terms and conditions, in addition to cost and schedule.

Who you are:
You have internalized that an SPM plays a dual leadership role on a program—an initiator to compel the supplier and the program to meet commitments. You are equally comfortable balancing risk between LM and Subcontractors, during negotiations and execution, to deliver an efficient custom solution. You understand that as an SPM you will use both LM and supplier schedules, requirement needs, and giver/receiver exchanges to push each party to drive program execution.
You are a strategic, pro-active, leader with deep experience in your technical field. You have a proven background creating clarity and motivating with vision that you are able to communicate to all levels—technician to executive. You are, or will soon be able to, operate almost entirely independently and accept accountability in turn. You have been recognized by our key customers for your impact on program performance.
You are a mentor in technical topics for custom engineered deliverables and want to grow that to include programmatic and contractual expertise. You mentor with patience, professionalism and a growth mindset.

The work:
As a Subcontract Program Manager Sr Stf, you will oversee all cost, schedule, and technical performance aspects of our subcontractors and suppliers. You will be the lead of the Subcontract Management Team (SMT), ensuring that every facet of subcontract management – from request for proposal (RFP) to delivery – aligns with program objectives and performance goals. Your leadership will drive the collaboration between Program Managers, Subcontract Administrators, Engineering, Specialties, and your Suppliers to ensure compliant execution within cost and schedule constraints.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the Subcontract Management Team (SMT) to develop and maintain a consistent business rhythm, ensuring that cost, schedule, and technical objectives are met.
• Oversee the end-to-end subcontracting process, including RFP activities, negotiations, awards, and performance management.
• Ensure subcontractor performance aligns with program specifications, including cost, schedule, quality, and earned value requirements.
• Manage and release deliverables, including Statements of Work (SOWs) and Subcontract Data Requirements Lists (SDRLs).

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education.
- 5+ years experience optical engineering .
- Experience in the development, assembly, integration, test and delivery of optical hardware.
- Able to author a supplier statement of work with minimal guidance.
- Able to work full-time on-site at the Louisville facility.
- Must be willing and able to travel to suppliers on short notice. Travel is primarily domestic, but could be international. Travel is expected to be minimal, e.g., for monthly 1-day PMRs—but could surge to 50-75% Mon-Fri if supplier performance falters. As the responsible SPM, the ability to represent LM on-site at a supplier is required.
- You will need to be a US Citizen and be able to obtain and maintain a US DoD TOP SECRET/SCI SAP with CI Poly clearance, to support this government contract, as well as successfully pass a drug and background check, in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

- Advanced understanding in the field. Advanced knowledge in navigating the processes, procedures, and execution of all phases of the program design cycle

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Job Description
The Next Generation Glide Body (NXGB) program is seeking motivated, high-potential employees for two Associate PM (APM) positions, one for the IRAD program, and one for the expected Scaled Hypersonics (SHY) Task Area 1 (TA-1) government funded program. The two roles will have different focus areas given the different phases of each program, but in general the roles will similarly assist the PMs with executing successfully.
NXGB began as a multi-year LM IRAD flight demo of an affordable, producible, and advanced intermediate range boost-glide hypersonic vehicle. It is an LM Space Key Investment (KI) and is in the LM Space Top 10 Priority Captures for 2026. The NXGB portfolio is extending beyond the IRAD to include a new SHY CRAD contract with a second flight opportunity, and the program is targeting downstream EMD and Production phases. The IRAD program is approaching CDR and moving into AI&T. The SHY program must incorporate new technology and thus will begin with a follow-on design phase.
What is an APM? The program has historically been led by a PM and a Deputy PM, but with the scaling that is underway, additional support is needed to ensure program operations are effectively maintained while concurrently providing full support to strategic planning, proposal efforts, and customer engagements. Therefore, APM roles are being stood up to assist the PMs with execution of each sub-program within the NXGB portfolio. It can be thought as of the transition between a CAM role and a full PM role. This is a unique opportunity to hone your program management skills alongside senior PMs with extensive experience on a high visibility program. Final decision authority for significant items will remain with the PMs.
Job Assignments
- Program Management : maintain program cost/schedule/technical baseline; ensure this occurs by tracking key metrics (EVM/etc) and developing Return to Green (RTG) plans as needed; utilize program performance data to make effective decisions; provide oversight to baseline reviews (BR/PAR); push formal changes to change boards for incorporation; maintain strong baseline control; execute CAM role for PM account
- Major Reviews & Documentation: provide oversight of content to effectively communicate tactical plan, status, priorities, key decisions, help needed, and other information critical to all stakeholders; for IRAD this includes the Product Development Agreement (PDA) and Key Investment (KI) Reviews; for SHY it includes contract deliverables, GFX management, and customer reviews; both APMs must also inform OppHub / NBFHub updates via MSAC
- Risk & Opps : ensure the R&O database is adequate to inform decisions; optimize the path forward by mitigating risks and exploiting opportunities; integrate across product areas and subprograms
- Staffing/Onboarding : ensure VEMO updates are completed and requisitions opened to align with future resource needs; support PMs and Strategic Assistant (SA) with tracking status and sourcing effectively

Basic Qualifications

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college and / or equivalent combined experience
- CAM experience or relative comparable experience as it relates to the position
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Desired Skills

Desired Skills
- Prior experience in project management with strong problem-solving and organizational skills
- Ability to own your domain with limited oversight
- Recognition as high potential employee
- Career plan targeting IPT Lead / PM roles
- Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
- Prior IRAD and/or Business Development experience
- Experience as direct liaison to customers/executives
- Maintenance of positive demeanor in environment with competing priorities

The AMMM portfolio includes international and domestic sales across the C-130J, P-3, and C-5 platforms, with this role providing strategic and tactical financial leadership across multiple development efforts, including Diminishing Manufacturing Resources (DMS), Special Missions, and major Key Investment activities. The Senior Manager will lead operational excellence and financial execution by overseeing financial controls, reporting, planning, and analysis; leading a team of business analysts; and partnering with Program Management, Finance, CAMs, and other cross-functional leaders to drive cost-effective outcomes. Responsibilities include monthly financial reporting and analysis, EAC, CSR/LRP planning, scenario and sensitivity analysis, IBR and PAR performance reporting, and identification of financial trends, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to support senior leadership decisions. The role will also oversee team development, performance management, recruitment, onboarding, and career progression while leading financial activities related to contract negotiations, cost proposals, and partner discussions. Additionally, the Senior Manager will develop and implement innovative solutions to improve cost efficiency, schedule performance, and overall program execution while evaluating and prioritizing strategic business initiatives in partnership with program and functional leadership.

Works in the Finance and Business Operations organization supporting program/product areas. Responsible for driving business results for a major program or portfolio of programs by integrating data from various teams including program finance, master planning, estimating, contracts, engineering, supply chain and other functions. Manages short and long-range financial and program performance internally and externally. Internal financial management includes contract orders, sales, profit, cash, capital expenditures and overhead costs. External management involves earned value management, program budget baselines and program performance reporting including estimates at completion. Assess issues, risks and opportunities that affect business portfolio/program performance and help develop associated action plans in coordination with program management. Interface and partner with external customers and internal stakeholders. Supports new business pursuits in development of executable and competitive proposals. Plays a key role in strategic business case development and analysis to support financial and operational decisions such as business integrations, enterprise investments, financial system/application strategies and other critical activities. (for the Leader only description) Responsible for managing a team of finance professionals and coordinating employee recruitment, talent development, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions.

Travel up to 25% may be required.

• Experience with leading, motivating or mentoring a diverse team of Program Finance professionals in a dynamic program environment.
• Experience using business acumen with proven experience in strategic thinking and tactical implementation.
• Experience with enterprise-level cost management tools (SAP, Cobra, etc.).

Desired Skills

• 12 years of experience in Finance demonstrated increasing responsibilities over that period
• Strong leadership skills and proven management experience to lead a F&BO team working across the enterprise, collaborating with and influencing others.
• Ability to analyze and interpret complex business information. developing and presenting data analysis to senior leaders
• Strong acumen, leadership, and track record in cost management and creative business solutions including LRP & Financial forecasting and planning experience

Standard Job Description

Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Seeking an experienced professional to provide program management capture, planning and execution leadership as the Black Hawk Multiyear XI (MYXI) Program Manager. Establish performance standards and track progress toward key milestones and deliverables.

Oversee functional team execution for production to ensure alignment with program goals.

Lead or support escalations, providing clear communication of status and issues across technical, non-technical, and executive audiences.

jobs.title: Production Operations Manager - AIR6500 Production Operations
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Eligibility: Applicants must be Australian citizens and be eligible to obtain and maintain an active Australian Government Defence security clearance at the level required for the position.

AIR6500 is the RAAF’s $3 billion program to develop a joint air battle management system that builds on the capabilities offered by Next Generation sensor and command and control systems. AIR6500 will create a fully networked ‘system of systems’ that synchronises air and missile Defence operations in joint and coalition environments, maximising situational awareness and enhancing the speed of decision making across the battlespace.
The AIR6500 Production Operations Manager is the single point of contact for all manufacturing‑operations matters on the AIR6500 program. The incumbent establishes and leads the production capability for the Program, and is accountable to program management for delivering hardware on schedule, cost and quality. Additionally the role will be responsible for managing production requirements for program from concept to execution.  This role bridges the Production, Engineering, Sourcing and Quality functions within the Program to ensure a seamless transition from concept through production at the Adelaide and Newcastle facilities.
This role can either be based from Adelaide or Newcastle with some travel as required.

Key responsibilities

- Support Design To Production - Advise and support the AIR6500 Engineering and Technology (E&T) team members in design of product via Integrated Product Team (IPT) support to ensure alignment with the program’s overall schedule and cost targets.
- Lead Production Execution - Lead the production team to meet program production milestones, resolve production issues, and drive continious improvement across Production disciplines
- Production Planning & Scheduling  Deliver successful execution of the production schedule through the MRP system – load demand, manage material procurement, and drive internal build execution to meet milestone dates and cost targets.
- Make/Buy Policy Enforcement – Champion the Make/Buy policy, conduct value‑engineered trade studies and present formal business cases to senior leadership.
- Financial & Earned‑Value Management – Serve as Control Account Manager (CAM) for AIR6500 Production.  Own budgeting, cost‑accountability (CAM) and Earned‑Value reporting.
- Stakeholder & Interface Management – Serve as the primary liaison between the AIR6500 Hardware Factory leadership, Platforms IPT members (Engineering, Sourcing, and Quality) and the AIR6500 Production team.
- Mentorship & Workforce Development – Lead, coach and develop AIR6500 Production Operations staff; foster a culture of continuous improvement.
- Risk & Opportunity Management – Lead AIR6500 Production Team risk‑and‑opportunity identification, mitigation and reporting in line with AS4360.

What you'll bring

To be considered, it is essential you demonstrate the following skills and experience:
- Extensive experience leading Production and Manufacturing for Defence Programs
- Establishment and management of a Production Capability for Defence programs
- Extensive experience in leading production teams on development programs
- Advanced planning, stakeholder engagement and execution of an ERP rollout
- Expert  planning, organisational, and management skills within multi-discipline project teams
- Extensive experience with the development of Business Cases and Proposals
- Expert demonstrated understanding of the interfaces between stakeholders in Production, Procurement, Quality, ILS and Engineering
- Expert demonstrated experience in financial management and reporting
- Expert demonstrated understanding of the interactions between the Production, Engineering, Program Management, Finance, commercial, Quality and support areas

This role will lead a team of Block 4 Program Managers and help drive capability insertion proposals through the lifecycle from requirement maturity through proposal development, negotiation, and contract award. The selected candidate will provide portfolio-level leadership across proposal strategy, capability roadmap alignment, supplier integration, contract structure, negotiation readiness, and cross-functional execution planning.
This role requires a program manager who can operate across both development and sustainment environments, understand how capabilities mature and integrate over time, and translate complex technical, supplier, funding, and customer priorities into executable proposal and award strategies.

- Lead the Block 4 Capability Insertion team by providing program management direction, portfolio integration, prioritization, coaching, and escalation support.

- Maintain visibility across active and emerging Block 4 capability areas, including 40PX, 41PX, 42PX, and future capability insertion efforts.

- Program management, project management, proposal management, development, modernization, sustainment, or aerospace program experience.
- Experience leading complex, cross-functional work across multiple stakeholders.
- Experience coordinating with functions such as Engineering, Contracts, Supply Chain, Pricing, Business Management, suppliers, or customer stakeholders.
- Experience managing proposal lifecycle activities from requirement maturity through proposal development, negotiation, and contract award.
- Experience with cross functional communications, leading, prioritizing, and problem-solving.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS) Training Logistics and Simulation (TLS) line of business, headquartered in Orlando, FL, USA, is a global industry provider of training and sustainment products and services.
The business is focused on 21 st Century Security for our customers and partners, in line with our OneLM Culture delivered under our 1LMX Transformation program.

Reporting through to the Vice President of Air and Commercial Solutions, the Program Management Director is accountable for the performance, transformation and growth of our Global Training Services mission area which operates across multiple international customers and locations. The role is accountable for all aspects of the business, including safety, quality, customer relations, people and talent management, program performance and all associated financial resources and results.
This role is ideally based in Canberra, however due to the high volume of both domestic and international travel required, other locations where LMA have a presence will be considered.

Key Responsibilities

You will offer significant knowledge and experience in managing a portfolio of domestic and international large-scale complex development, production and sustainment programs and are a recognizable leader in the aerospace and defense sector.
You have demonstrated full spectrum leadership skills and experience leading diverse, multi-national, distributed and virtual teams and proven capability in building effective customer and supplier relationships. You are a strategic leader with proven experience developing and executing growth strategies.

About Lockheed Martin

Lockheed Martin is a dynamic organisation, providing stimulating and challenging opportunities with a global team of over 122,000 professionals. We embrace flexibility, so our people can be their best inside and outside of work. As a leader in national security, our innovative and diverse programs create a more secure future for Australia across space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains.

Special Requirements
Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance and employment may be contingent on the provision of further personal information including citizenship to ensure compliance with international export control legislation and regulations.

Veteran Friendly Workplace
Veterans are encouraged to apply. We highly value the unique skills and experiences that veterans and transitioning service members can contribute to our team. We are proud to be recognised as a Veteran Friendly Employer by the Australian Government.

Equal Opportunity
Lockheed Martin Australia supports Equal Employment Opportunity and values diversity in the workplace by creating a place of employment that is, free of unlawful discrimination and is harassment free, fair, ethical, inclusive, and values the contribution of all its employees. By leveraging our employees’ unique talents and experiences, we will deliver innovative, affordable solutions and unparalleled customer value.
As part of our endeavours to increase participation of Indigenous Australians, we welcome applications from all people, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are selected for this role, we would be happy to discuss any adjustments that will help you to be successful.

What you'll bring

You will have experience with US Foreign Military Sales and Australian Government Contracting. Familiarity with US Government Export Controls and prior experience working for and/or with US Prime Contractors is desirable.

- Demonstrated full spectrum leadership skills
- Proven capability in building effective supplier and customer relationships
- Experience leading multinational, distributed and virtual teams
- Prior experience developing and executive successful growth strategies
- Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice

jobs.title: F35 Training Operations Manager / Swidwin / Poland
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin is seeking a Training Operations Manager (TOM) to support and lead F 35 training operations in Swidwin, Poland.

The selected candidate will manage and execute daily F 35 training operations team activities, support Polish Air Force (PAF) military pilots to maintain qualification levels using Full Mission Simulators (F Sim) and other F 35 Pilot Training Devices (PTDs), and assist in executing customer approved pilot training syllabi, upgrades, and tactics training. The instructor will operate the Instructor Operating Station (IOS) and be an F 35 Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting pilot training and tactics development, as well as recommendations for courseware updates.
The successful candidate will work closely with other members of the Lockheed Martin team at dedicated training sites to fulfill F 35 training and continuation training objectives. They will also implement and support Lockheed Martin initiatives, programs, and policies, as directed. The candidate must maintain a Secret level security clearance and Special Access Program (SAP) access. They must also possess an appropriate degree from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education, with professional experience and specialized training commensurate with assignment.
Primary duties include
• Build, coordinate and schedule daily training related activities and manage all permanent party and visiting RMS personnel.
• Manage personnel hiring actions, logistical coordination for base access and badging (IVRs), Visit Access Requests (VARs), SOU U/SOU C access, lodging, and site integration.
• Conduct daily, weekly and monthly coordination with the PAF to merge training priorities into a coherent, executable schedule to support customer needs and ensure contract obligations are fulfilled.
• Oversee continuous training (CT) and formal syllabi course preparation, including Scenario Generation development for all training missions, briefing guide updates, and conversion of instructional materials to PAF standards.
• Coordinate with PAF Training and Standardization & Evaluation personnel to ensure proper training flow and execution of customer training programs, including syllabus adherence, instructor availability, and grade sheet completion.
• Manage and assist in the maintenance and advancement of the site’s training devices, including courseware and IT equipment arrival and integration, hardware and software installs, configuration management, audits and related activities, as directed by the RMS Enterprise team.
Additional duties
• Employee engagement: Provide performance feedback to employees and engage with them on career goals and development.
• Assist in the preparation of training and maintenance schedules, compliance of personnel training records, and adherence to enterprise standards.
• Evaluate and monitor students’ performance from course start through graduation.
• Work closely with other Lockheed Martin team members at additional training sites to fulfill F 35 schoolhouse and continuation training objectives.
The job may require a flexible work schedule to provide coverage for on site customer requirements.
Additional Responsibilities
• Customer coordination with scheduling (operations and maintenance): Provide the designated customer representative with a proposed “30 90 day” plan for approval of PTD utilization, including scheduled maintenance downtime.
• Sortie Completion and Readiness Reporting (SCAR): Accurate and timely submission of daily and weekly training and device information.

Basic Qualifications

• Active Secret clearance with final adjudication within the last five years, and ability to qualify for, acquire, and hold a SAP clearance.
• Flight time in fourth and/or fifth generation fighter aircraft.
• In depth knowledge of military publications and understanding of fourth and/or fifth generation aircraft training operations.
• Prior experience delivering military pilot academics and simulator training; familiarity with current instructional techniques and delivery methods.
• Proven ability to work collaboratively with cross functional teams and stakeholders from varied backgrounds.
• Outstanding interpersonal, leadership, oral & written communication, and organizational skills; strong customer service focus.
• Demonstrated leadership in managing operations personnel supporting customer mission readiness at dedicated training and operational installations.
• Alignment with Lockheed Martin core values and Full Spectrum Leadership imperatives.
• Experience evaluating personnel performance and completing performance appraisals.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
• Four year degree from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education, with professional experience and specialized training commensurate with the assignment.
• Selected applicant may be required to work rotating shifts, and work in excess of 40 hours.

Desired Skills

• Experience interfacing with senior ranking military customer representatives.
• Experience with F 35 pilot training curriculum.
• Familiarity with F 35 program requirements and system knowledge.
• F 35 Full Mission Simulator experience.
• Familiarity with the F 35 ALIS program.
• Current possession of F 35 Program special access.
• 1,000+ hours fighter flight time in fourth and/or fifth generation fighter aircraft.
• Prior experience as an F 35 Contractor Instructor Pilot (CIP) or F 35 Pilot SME.
• Previous experience with the Polish Air Force customer.
• Familiarity with Polish flight rules, procedures, and operations.

OCONUS Locale: Swidwin is a small town in northwest Poland, situated close to the German border and approximately 60 miles east of Szczecin, Poland, and 160 miles from Berlin, Germany. It provides easy access to major transport routes and a growing aerospace/defense cluster, while offering a lower cost of living than larger Polish cities. Residents enjoy modern infrastructure, a multilingual setting (Polish, English, German), rich cultural heritage, and ample outdoor recreation—making it an appealing base for professionals seeking a balanced work life environment in Central Europe.

Standard Job Description

Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, proposal work statements and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Develops new business or expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.

WHAT WE'RE DOING

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we are inspired by innovation and integrity. We believe that by applying the highest standards of business ethics and creative thinking, everything is within our reach – and yours as a Lockheed Martin employee. Lockheed Martin values your skills, training and education. Come and experience your future!
THE WORK
The Program Manager will support the Emerging Sensors sub-market segment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the execution of programmatic tasks and be provided responsibility for the applicable program sales, EBIT and cash commitments. The candidate responsibilities will include developing & executing to program baselines as well as support of proposal efforts.
This scope includes:
• Defining and sustaining program rhythms and organizational structures.
• Coordinating cross functional design, build, and test activities, while proactively resolving issues that impact schedule, cost, or performance.
• Leading proposal development and supporting bid to win strategies.
• Steering risk and opportunity management processes, providing timely visibility to leadership and ensuring mitigation actions are executed.
The role demands an organized, results oriented Program Manager with proven capability of coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver results.

jobs.title: Program Management Mgr - L5
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

The Deputy Program Manager will support/lead the end‑to‑end development of a portfolio of Electro-Optical systems. This role is responsible for defining program strategy, coordinating cross‑functional teams, managing schedules, budgets, and risk, and ensuring that deliverables meet performance, cost, and schedule objectives in support of advanced mission‑critical systems.
- Program Leadership – Define, execute, and own the program roadmap for electro optical hardware, from concept through production.
- Cross‑Functional Coordination – Partner with systems engineering, firmware, software, mechanical, test, procurement, and subcontracts teams to align requirements and meet program milestones.
- Schedule & Budget Management – Develop and maintain detailed master schedules, resource plans, and budgets; track progress and implement corrective actions as needed.
- Risk & Issue Management – Identify technical and programmatic risks, implement mitigation strategies, and communicate status to senior leadership.
- Technical Oversight – Provide guidance on architecture, component selection, PCB design, signal integrity, and thermal management; ensure compliance with aerospace standards.
- Stakeholder Communication – Prepare and deliver regular status briefings, performance metrics, and executive dashboards.
- Supplier & Contract Management – Lead supplier selection, qualification, and performance monitoring for parts, sub‑assemblies, and manufacturing.
- Configuration & Change Control – Enforce PLM processes, manage baselines, and control documentation throughout the product life cycle.
- Team Development – Mentor junior engineers and program staff; foster a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Standard Job Description: Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion.  Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, proposal work statements and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Develops new business or expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.  Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelors or higher degree in an Engineering or related discipline
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously
- Experience with the development of complex state of the art systems for ground and space applications
- Demonstrated Control Account Manager (CAM) experience, including managing program budgets, schedules, and resources
- Demonstrated experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and the ability to use EVM metrics to track program performance, identify trends, and make corrective actions when necessary.
- Demonstrated experience in working with multiple functions and disciplines such as engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain
- Strong communication skills
- Active Top Secret clearance

Desired Skills

- Master's Degree in related field
- Experience in Optics, Opto-mechanical, or Electro-Optical related industry
- Proposal support and/or management experience
- Experience managing subcontracts
- Experience with optical, opto-mechanical,  or electro-optical systems for ground and space applications
- Proven ability to lead in a remote/hybrid environment, including experience managing virtual teams, facilitating remote meetings, and using remote collaboration tools.
- Demonstrated experience managing procurements, including identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring on-time delivery of goods and services.
- Demonstrated experience with Risk and Opportunity Management, including identifying, assessing, and mitigating program risks, and capitalizing on program opportunities.
- Demonstrated experience with developing and maintaining Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) and budgets, and the ability to use IMS and budget data to track program performance, identify trends, and make corrective actions when necessary.

jobs.title: Subcontract Program Management Sr Stf - E5
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

What We’re Doing
At Sikorsky, a Lockheed Martin company, we are at the forefront of rotorcraft innovation, delivering cutting-edge helicopters and aviation solutions. We are dedicated to advancing technology and driving excellence in aerospace.
At the Owego, NY location, we support the Sikorsky Line of Business (LoB) with a focus on the Maritime Systems Market Segment and the Maritime Sustainment Programs.
The Work
This Supply Chain Management role directly supports the capture effort of the Contract Renewal Proposal for the Seahawk Performance Based Logistics (PBL) Program. The Seahawk PBL Program is recognized for its excellent performance in supporting the MH-60R/S fleet and long standing relationship between LM-Sikorsky and the NAVSUP customer.
As a lead Subcontract Program Manager (SPM), you will be leading a team of Subcontract Program Managers and Subcontract Administrators during capture strategy, Requests For Proposals (RFPs), source selections, proposal evaluations, gate reviews for the LM proposal, negotiations and definitizing of subcontracts, and risk and opportunity management. You will be a member of the Capture Team for the Seahawk PBL Renewal contract, representing the Supply Chain Team. You will support submitting a compliant TINA proposal and required disclosures, negotiations, contract award, and execution that is heavily weighted on subcontracted scope on this Sustainment program. You will be a liaison between Capture Team, Program Office, and the Supply Chain team.
Key responsibilities include:
- Leading strategic subcontract management plans for program capture and execution.
- Serving as the primary interface between sourcing team, subcontractors, engineering, pricing, obsolescence management, compliance, and program management.
- Managing all phases of subcontracts, from make/buy decisions to RFPs, negotiations, and program execution.
- Ensuring that subcontract milestones are met by directing cross-functional Subcontract Management Teams (SMTs).
- Developing subcontract specifications, work statements, and handling prime contract flow-downs.
- Managing supplier Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs) and addressing Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages (DMSMS) to mitigate obsolescence.
- Plan and manage the subcontractor relationships and communications.
- Support the Capture Team in: developing supplier requirements, performing initial risk assessments; and documenting the subcontract strategy approach and selection criteria.
- Resolve, lead, and control the subcontracted scope and requirements baseline.
- Negotiate price and SOW requirements with suppliers
- Lead the Supply Chain team to award suppliers and establish program kick off
- Support perform execution by leading the supply chain team to manage suppliers to their contractual & performance requirements
Who You Are
You’re an experienced team leader with a deep understanding of subcontract management, especially in the aerospace and defense sectors. You have a proven track record of managing complex projects or subcontracts from initiation through execution, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery. You have a deep understanding of with the RMS Capture Process and experience with large complex proposals. You have an understanding of FAR and DFAR requirements as it relates Government Proposals and working with RMS procurement and estimating policies and procedures. Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of or progressive experience related to subcontract management

Desired Skills

- Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)
- Previous experience working capture efforts E.g. Basis of Estimates (BOE), Statements of work, writing supplier agreements
- CAM certification
- Demonstrated knowledge of SAP
- Experience with FAR 15 and FAR 12 supplier proposals
- Sustainment Program experience
- Previous Lockheed MArtin Supply Chain experience
- Bachelors degree

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

The selected candidate will serve as a Program Management Staff member supporting the F-35 Sustainment Program and will be responsible for driving complex proposal efforts from inception through contract award for Component Depot Activations (CDA). This individual contributor role requires strong program management, proposal execution, cross-functional coordination, and customer engagement skills to successfully develop and negotiate proposals in support of program and business objectives.

The Proposal Program Manager will serve as the primary program management focal point for assigned proposals, coordinating activities across Engineering, Contracts, Business Management, Global Supply Chain, Finance, and other functional organizations. Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security, and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire, and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. jobs.title: Program Management Stf - E4
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Tracks cost, schedule and technical performance across the production portfolio. Interface with customers (internal and external) during production status meetings for critical materials and open issues for the program. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changes. Implement updates from contract modifications or production demands by authoring program directives. Performs earned value management as a control account manager and maintains operating budgets. Coordinate risks and opportunities among the production leadership teams (PLTs). Acts as primary contact for impromptu program activities. Supports internal program reviews with Enterprise Performance to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Partners with leadership team and supports key production acceleration initiatives for both internal and external customers.
•    Track cost, schedule, and technical performance as Program Management Control Account Manager (PM CAM) - Support earned value management activities as a control account contributor; maintain and update operating budget data.
•    Coordinate and track a singular Estimate at Complete Change Request (ECR) and Multi-Year Procurement Economic Order Quantity (MYP EOQ) decision database across the production program
•    Participate in production status meetings with internal and external customers, documenting critical material updates and open issues, and validate actions are driven into each PLT
•    Assist in establishing milestones and monitor adherence to master plans and detailed schedules; flag deviations for resolution.
•    Identify program problems and help develop corrective actions (e.g., resource reallocations, schedule adjustments) under guidance of senior leadership.
•    Draft and disseminate program directives to implement contract modifications, production demand changes, and or enablers.
•    Coordinate risk and opportunity registers with Production Leadership Teams (PLTs), ensuring timely communication and mitigation planning – Act as cross PLT R&O facilitator
•    Prepare materials for internal program reviews with Enterprise Performance, summarizing cost, schedule, and technical performance metrics.
•    Collaborate with LG 4/5 PMs to ensure consistent execution of program processes, PLT/SMT content, and program standards.
•    Attend all formal program onboarding and technical briefings; capture lessons learned lead incorporation into the production program
Why Join Us
The ideal candidate is a collaborative, results‑driven professional who thrives in a fast‑paced environment. This role offers high visibility, direct impact on program outcomes, and the opportunity to work alongside senior leadership on critical acceleration initiatives.

This position is located in Dallas, TX

- Bachelor’s degree or higher with at least 5 years or more technical and/or relevant experience
- Must have the ability to obtain an Interim Secret after accepting an offer and before starting the role if selected
- Production experience in operations, supply chain, and/or quality
- Ability to thrive and adapt in a fast‑changing, global landscape
- Earned Value Management and/or Enhanced Program Reporting System (EPRS) experience
- Risk and opportunity management experience
- Experience driving issues to resolution across multiple functions and/or organizations

Desired Skills

- Experience supporting a government customer
- Excellent communication and relationship skills, both verbal and written, with the proven ability to communicate to all levels internally and externally.
- Strong business acumen, including negotiation and conflict management skills.
- Master of Business Administration (MBA) or advanced technical degree
- Program/Project Management experience
- Experience communicating with executives and customers internal and external to program
- Ability to address complex issues and solutions with senior leadership
- Knowledge of missile production / sustainment / development processes.
- Willingness to engage with technical and non-technical subject matter experts in a variety of functions and/or organizations.
